bugs.error_message: Compiled dist/**/*.js contained no "use client" directives anywhere after `tsup` build (verified via `head -c N` on every output file) — RSC client/server boundaries would have been silently broken for any Server Component importing an interactive package component.
bugs.root_cause: tsup's default esbuild bundling (bundle: true, ESM code-splitting across 5 barrel entry points) merges multiple source modules into shared chunks. esbuild treats the bare `"use client";` string-literal expression statement as dead code (it isn't part of the ECMAScript spec) and strips it during bundling, regardless of which source files it came from.
bugs.fix: Set `bundle: false` in tsup.config.ts so every src/**/*.{ts,tsx} file transpiles 1:1 into dist/ with no chunk merging, which preserves the directive naturally per file. Added packages/shadcn/scripts/postbuild-use-client.mjs as a safety net that reads each dist file's .js.map `sources` array and re-prepends "use client" if a compiled file traces back to a source file that has it but the directive is missing.
